text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's economic growth to exceed 1996 forecast. Deficit continues decline, performance of economic sectors is likely to recover.

- Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Sulman al-Khalifa issues a decree declaring Hawar islands and surrounding territorial water a wildlife sanctuary. Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a dispute over the islands.
- Emir, prime minister meet a U.S. delegation. Discussion focused on the latest development in the region. Bahrain has agreed to host 23 F-16 U.S. fighters on its territory.
